narrative.overview: Sentinel is built for rapid error triage, log inspection, support ticket tracking, and real-time observability. Its visual system prioritizes extreme data density, instant scannability, and high-contrast status feedback.
keyCharacteristics: High Information Density: Compact tables, zero-padding bloat, and sharp tabular alignment.
Precision Color System: Monochromatic slate-gray surfaces with high-chroma status accents.
Monospace Telemetry: Monospace typography for stack traces, error IDs, timestamps, and key-value attributes.
Zero Decorative Fluff: Rejects glassmorphism, decorative text gradients, and ambient blurs.

rules.name: The Signal-to-Noise Rule
rules.body: Saturated color carries less than 5% of any screen surface.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: All numeric metrics and error IDs must use tabular numbers or monospace fonts.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use box-shadow for container boundaries; use 1px solid #334155 borders.

rules.name: The Drawer-First Rule
rules.body: Never launch full-screen modal overlays; use right-hand sliding drawers or expandable inline rows.

dos: Do maintain high line density (36px–40px table row height).
Do use strict monospace formatting for error signatures, stack traces, and IDs.
Do use context-preserving drawers and inline expandable rows over disruptive modals.
donts: Don't use modal dialogs for issue inspection—always use a side drawer or inline detail panel.
Don't use decorative text gradients, hero-metric cards, or blurs.
Don't use colored accent side-stripes on cards or alert notifications.
Don't hide critical error context behind multi-click pagination.
